    Forest SnacksGlowing forest fruit skewersDragon fruit, kiwi, pineapple and blueberries with lime and honeyHow to make it1 dragon fruit2 kiwifruits1/4 pineapple125g blueberries1 lime2 tbsp honeyCut the dragon fruit, kiwifruit and pineapple into chunks.Thread onto skewers with the blueberries.Drizzle with lime juice and honey.Serve on a dark board under low light.Hallelujah Mountains baoSoy ginger braised pork belly in steamed buns with pickled cucumber and peanutsHow to make it600g pork belly125ml soy sauce1 knob ginger, sliced2 star anises12 bao buns2 Lebanese cucumbers1 small bunch coriander50g peanuts, crushedPut the pork belly in a pot with soy, ginger, star anise and water.Simmer until tender.Slice the pork and pickle the cucumber in a little vinegar and salt.Steam the bao buns.Fill with pork, pickled cucumber, coriander and crushed peanuts.Hometree lemongrass fish in banana leafFillets in chilli, garlic and lime paste, grilled in leaves, opened for the clan, nam jimHow to make itNot on tonight's cookFirm white fish rubbed with a paste of lemongrass, chilli, garlic and lime, wrapped in banana leaves and grilled, unwrapped at the table with nam jim.Blitz 2 lemongrass stalks, 2 red chillies, 3 garlic cloves, a knob of ginger, a handful of coriander, the zest of a lime and 1 tbsp fish sauce to a paste.Cut 600g ling fillets into 8 pieces and coat in the paste.Wrap each in a square of softened banana leaf and pin with a toothpick.Grill over medium heat for 10 minutes.Mix lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and chilli for nam jim.From the FireHometree hunter's spit-roastLamb shoulder roasted 5 hours for the clan, before Hometree fallsHow to make it1.8kg lamb shoulder4 cloves of garlic2 sprigs of rosemary2 tsp smoked paprika6 flatbreads1 bunch mint1 bunch parsleyRub the lamb with crushed garlic, rosemary and paprika.Roast covered at 150°C until it pulls apart.Rest and shred the lamb.Toss mint and parsley into a salad.Serve with warm flatbreads and the salad.Ikran flight prawn and pumpkin curryKing prawns simmered in coconut milk with green paste, lime leaves and Thai basil, jasmine riceHow to make itNot on tonight's cookKing prawns and pumpkin simmered in coconut milk with green curry paste, lime leaves and fish sauce, Thai basil folded through, with jasmine rice.Fry 3 tbsp green curry paste in 2 tbsp coconut cream for 2 minutes until fragrant.Add 400ml coconut milk, 200ml water, 4 torn lime leaves and 500g pumpkin in 2cm chunks and simmer 12 minutes until tender.Add 600g peeled green king prawns and simmer 3 minutes.Season with 2 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tsp palm sugar, then fold through Thai basil.Serve with 300g steamed jasmine rice.Sweet ThingsTree of Souls puddingTapioca pearls like the seeds of the sacred tree, with coconut, mango and passionfruitHow to make it100g tapioca pearls800ml coconut milk400ml water80g caster sugar2 mangoes, diced4 passionfruits30g shredded coconut, toastedSimmer the tapioca in coconut milk, water and sugar until clear.Chill.Layer in glasses with mango and passionfruit pulp.Top with toasted coconut.Gourds and CupsWoodsprite blue lagoonCoconut water and pineapple juice over ice, blue curaçao added for adultsHow to make it600ml coconut water600ml pineapple juice60ml blue curaçao4 pineapple wedges1 bag iceFill four glasses with ice.Pour in coconut water and pineapple juice.Add a splash of blue curacao for the adults.Garnish with a pineapple wedge.Coconut water with passionfruitI see you.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
